title: 第806章 因为太弱，所以被误会了吗？
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

谢灵玉沉稳落座，目光侧望向神情自若仿佛这里是自家宗门的楚星尘。

两大掌舵人碰面之前，很多事情和底线早就已经商谈的差不多了，某种意义上来说，这次只是一个大概走过程的行动。

毕竟两大掌舵人面对面的吵又冷嘲热讽的，不管谁吵赢了也只是他人的笑柄罢了。

这次过程走后，佛门的行动便可以说是和楚星尘的联合，属于昭告天下佛门依然是正儿八经的好宗门。

楚星尘自如的说这些官话，夸赞着佛门金碧生辉，人才济济，果真是个天底下的好地方。

如难便回夸楚星尘少年英才，天定英雄，愿挽天倾的天顶星好少年。

漂亮话已经成为两人开口的前缀，句号便是相见恨晚，为什么不能早点认识对方。

五句话里四句半皆是恭维。

谢灵玉自然也会被如难连带的夸上两句，她也点头回应，只是漂亮话明显说的不如面皮无双的两人。

她目光微微向四周看去，望向周遭佛陀，脑海之中也一一辨别这些人的名号以及是因果佛还是尘世佛。

很快谢灵玉也发现了一些比较特别的事——脸上带着些许温和笑意的几乎全是因果佛，神色平静连恭维笑意都不多的大多是尘世佛。

仔细想来，原因大概便是无论楚星尘到底怎么做的承诺，事实上的确一直在兜底光明佛陀。

大乘佛法一事对于这些尘世佛来说一直是悬在头顶的利剑。

毕竟谁也不想一觉醒来，奋斗了大半辈子的佛门眨眼就把自己扫地出门，还得被嘲讽是个假和尚，加入佛门也只是因为佛门的权势。

虽然原因真的是这般，但是说出来就有点刺耳了。

心照不宣的事情说出口就是大声辱骂。

不过大势在前，倒也真没人不开眼的来损毁表面上其乐融融的会谈。

尊佛脸上温和的笑意从未断过。

楚星尘也收敛了性子，一副佛门真是大前辈的神情。

一些早就谈妥的事情被一件件的聊了出来，如难也不用向其他佛陀商议，只是笑着点着头简单聊了聊就点头应允。

一件件能让天地格局焕然一新的大事就在两人恭维的商谈之中落下帷幕。

佛门划定了参与其中的利益。

楚星尘需要配合佛门的一系列宣传行动。

会议的结束是如难一句——煌煌大道，勉励共行之后落下帷幕。

谢灵玉没接上几句话，她目光微抬，目光望向了又掏出留影石的楚星尘，以及仍然十分配合的如难。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xie Lingyu sat down calmly and looked sideways at Chu Xingchen, who looked as calm as if he was from his own sect.

Before the two leaders met, many things and the bottom line had already been discussed. In a sense, this time it was just a rough process.

After all, the two helmsmen were quarreling and sarcastic face to face. No matter who won the argument, he would just be the laughing stock of others.

After this process is over, Buddhism's actions can be said to be a union with Chu Xingchen, and it is a good sect that tells the world that Buddhism is still a serious sect.

Chu Xingchen spoke these mandarin words freely, praising Buddhism for its splendor and talent. It was indeed a great place in the world.

If it is difficult, I will praise Chu Xingchen as a talented young man, a destined hero, a good young man from Zenith Star who is willing to turn the sky.

Beautiful words have become the prefix for the two of them to talk, and the end is that they met each other too late, why can't they get to know each other earlier.

Four and a half out of five sentences are compliments.

Xie Lingyu was naturally complimented by Ru Nan, and she nodded in response, but her words were obviously not as good as those of the two incomparable faces.

She looked around slightly, looking at the Buddhas around her, and in her mind, she identified the names of these people one by one and whether they were Karmic Buddhas or Earthly Buddhas.

Soon Xie Lingyu also discovered something special - almost all the people with gentle smiles on their faces were Karma Buddhas, and most of the people with calm expressions and no complimentary smiles were Earthly Buddhas.

If you think about it carefully, the reason is probably that no matter what Chu Xingchen promised, in fact, he had always been telling the truth about the Buddha of Light.

For these earthly Buddhas, the matter of Mahayana Buddhism has always been a sharp sword hanging over their heads.

After all, no one wants to wake up and find themselves kicked out of Buddhism after struggling for most of their lives in the blink of an eye. They have to be ridiculed as a fake monk. They only join Buddhism because of its power.

Although the reason is really like this, it is a bit harsh to say it.

Saying things that are tacitly understood is a loud insult.

However, the general trend is forward, and no one really wants to ruin the seemingly pleasant talks without opening their eyes.

The gentle smile on the Buddha's face never ceased.

Chu Xingchen also calmed down his temper, looking like a senior in Buddhism.

Some things that had been agreed upon long ago were discussed one by one. If there was a problem, there was no need to discuss it with other Buddhas. They just smiled and nodded after a brief chat before nodding in agreement.

One after another, major events that could completely change the pattern of heaven and earth came to an end in the complimentary discussions between the two.

Buddhism delineates the interests involved.

Chu Xingchen needed to cooperate with Buddhism’s series of propaganda actions.

The meeting ended with a difficult sentence - the glorious road, and the curtain came to an end after encouraging us to walk together.

Xie Lingyu didn't say a few words. She raised her eyes slightly and looked at Chu Xingchen who took out the shadow stone again, and Ru Nan who was still very cooperative.
